```{r}
generate_random_strings <- function(num_strings = 11, string_length = 10) {
  # Define the character set to use for generating random strings
  character_set <- c(LETTERS, letters, 0:9)

  # Generate the random strings
  random_strings <- sapply(1:num_strings, function(i) {
    paste(sample(character_set, string_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")
  })

  return(random_strings)
}
```

```{r}
# Define the function to generate the vector
generate_special_vector <- function(seed = 123) {
  # Set the seed for reproducibility
  #set.seed(seed)

  # Initialize the vector with length 281
  vec <- numeric(281)

  # Randomly assign 100 entries as NA
  na_indices <- sample(1:281, 100)
  vec[na_indices] <- NA

  # Randomly assign 100 entries as 0
  zero_indices <- sample(setdiff(1:281, na_indices), 100)
  vec[zero_indices] <- 0

  # Fill the remaining entries with random integers between 1 and 9
  remaining_indices <- setdiff(1:281, union(na_indices, zero_indices))
  vec[remaining_indices] <- sample(1:9, length(remaining_indices), replace = TRUE)

  return(vec)
}


```

```{r}
generate_dataset_new <- function(n_samples) {
  # Define the metadata
  time_range <- c(
    "Zanclean", "Piacenzian", "Gelasian", "Calabrian", "Chibanian", "Tarantian",
    "Oldowan", "Acheulean", "Mousterian", "Aterian", "Aurignacian", "Gravettian",
    "Solutrean", "Magdalenian", "Natufian", "Kebaran", "Azilian", "Maglemosian",
    "Pre-Pottery Neolithic A", "Pre-Pottery Neolithic B", "Pottery Neolithic",
    "Chalcolithic", "Early Bronze Age", "Middle Bronze Age", "Late Bronze Age",
    "Early Iron Age", "Middle Iron Age", "Late Iron Age",
    "Medieval Period", "Early Modern Period", "Late Modern Period"
  )

  age_category <- c(
    "Infant (0-2 years)",
    "Child (3-7 years)",
    "Adolescent (8-16 years)",
    "Subadult",  # General category if specific age is not available
    "Adult (17+ years)"
  )

  gender <- c("Male", "Female", "Unknown")

  accumulation_cause <- c(
    "Cannibalism", "Burial", "Collective burial", "Mass graves",
    "Secondary position", "Surface disposal", "Disposal", "Scavenged",
    "Intentional accumulation", "Funerary assemblage", "Cemetery",
    "Cuevas Sepulcrales", "Transport or accumulation from carnivores",
    "Possible burial"
  )

  geological_context <- c(
    "Cave", "Sepulchral Cave", "Rockshelter", "Open air", "Surface disposal"
  )

  hominin_species <- c(
    "Australopithecus anamensis", "Australopithecus afarensis",
    "Australopithecus africanus", "Paranthropus aethiopicus",
    "Homo habilis", "Homo rudolfensis", "Paranthropus boisei",
    "Paranthropus robustus", "Homo ergaster", "Homo erectus",
    "Homo antecessor", "Homo heidelbergensis",
    "Neanderthals (Homo neanderthalensis)", "Denisovans",
    "Homo naledi", "Homo sapiens"
  )

  # Define site_index
  site_index <- paste0("Site_", 1:n_samples)

  # Create the dataset
  dataset <- c(
    1:n_samples,  # Sample index
    site_index,  # Site index
    paste0("Site_", 1:n_samples),  # Site name
    rep(1, n_samples),  # Sum (set to 1 for all rows)
    sample(time_range, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    sample(geological_context, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    sample(1:125, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    sample(age_category, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    sample(gender, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    sample(accumulation_cause, n_samples, replace = TRUE),
    sample(hominin_species, n_samples, replace = TRUE)
  )
  

  return(dataset)
}
```

```{r}
recal_mne_six <- function(current_mne,  target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, bone_names, sections_order) {
    current_levels = c(5,1,3,4,3,3,5,4,3,5)

  
  # Initialize results list
  new_mne <- list()
  
  # Create initial tibble with bone info
  current_mne_named <- tibble(count = current_mne, element = bone_names) %>%
    add_bone_info() %>%
    mutate(std_element = gsub(" ", ".", element))

  # Process each skeleton section
  for (part in sections_order) {
    part_idx <- which(sections_order == part)
    current_level <- current_levels[part_idx]
    target_level <- target_levels[part_idx]
    
    cat("\nProcessing", part, ": Starting at level", current_level, "-> Target", target_level, "\n")
    
    # Initialize working data
    working_data <- current_mne_named %>%
      filter(Skeleton_Section == part) %>%
      select(std_element, count)

    iteration <- 1
    while(current_level > target_level) {
      intermediate_level <- max(target_level, current_level - 1)
      mapping_name <- paste0(part, "_", current_level, "_to_", intermediate_level)
      
      if (mapping_name %in% names(category_hierarchy)) {
        # Create element-category mapping
        element_map <- stack(category_hierarchy[[mapping_name]]) %>%
          setNames(c("child", "parent")) %>%
          mutate(
            child = gsub(" ", ".", child),
            parent = gsub(" ", ".", parent)
          )
        
        # Split data into mappable and non-mappable elements
        mappable <- working_data %>%
          inner_join(element_map, by = c("std_element" = "child"))
        
        non_mappable <- working_data %>%
          anti_join(element_map, by = c("std_element" = "child"))
        
        # Aggregate mappable elements
        aggregated <- mappable %>%
          group_by(parent) %>%
          summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          rename(std_element = parent)
        
        # Combine with non-mappable elements
        working_data <- bind_rows(non_mappable, aggregated)
        
        current_level <- intermediate_level
        cat("  Step", iteration, "| Level:", current_level, "| Elements:", nrow(working_data), "\n")
        iteration <- iteration + 1
      } else {
        warning(paste("Missing mapping:", mapping_name))
        break
      }
    }
    
    # Store final results
    if(nrow(working_data) > 0) {
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(working_data))) {
        element_name <- paste(part, working_data$std_element[i], sep = "_")
        new_mne[[element_name]] <- working_data$count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Convert to tibble with proper ordering
  new_mne_df <- tibble(
    element = names(new_mne),
    count = unlist(new_mne)
  )
  
  return(new_mne_df)
}
```

```{r}
align_loaded_data <- function(one_skeleton, longer_elements, longer_counts) {

  shorter_elements <- sub(".*\\.", "",one_skeleton)
  longer_elements <- sub(".*\\_", "", gsub("\\.", " ", longer_elements)) 

  # Find the elements in the longer vector that are not in the shorter vector
  elements_to_remove <- longer_elements[!longer_elements %in% shorter_elements]

  # Find the positions of these elements in the longer vector
  positions_to_remove <- which(longer_elements %in% elements_to_remove)

  # Remove these elements and their corresponding counts from both vectors
  aligned_longer_elements <- longer_elements[-positions_to_remove]
  aligned_longer_counts <- longer_counts[-positions_to_remove]
  
  align_loaded_db <- data.frame(element = aligned_longer_elements, count = aligned_longer_counts)
  
  return(align_loaded_db)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

loaded_tapho <- function(meta, level, col_element, col_count) { 
  # Ensure that level is a 10-element vector
  if (length(level) != 10) {
    stop("The level vector must have exactly 10 elements.")
  }

  # Ensure that col_element and col_count are of the same length
  if (length(col_element) != length(col_count)) {
    stop("The length of col_element and col_count must be the same.")
  }

  # Create the tibble with the specified columns
  dataset <- tibble::tibble(
    site_index = meta[1],
    sample_index = meta[2],
    site_name = meta[3],
    sum = meta[4],
    time_range = meta[5],
    geological_context = meta[6],
    number_of_individuals = meta[7],
    age = meta[8],
    gender = meta[9],
    accumulation_cause = meta[10],
    hominin_species = meta[11],
    bone.level = list(level),  # Store level as a list
    element = list(col_element),  # Store col_element as a list
    count = list(col_count)  # Store col_count as a list
  )

  return(dataset)
}
```

```{r}
recal_mne_7 <- function(current_mne,target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, bone_names, sections_order, sum_cat = TRUE) {
    current_levels = c(5,1,3,4,3,3,5,4,3,5)
  # Initialize results list
  new_mne <- list()
  
  # Create initial tibble with bone info
  current_mne_named <- tibble(count = current_mne, element = bone_names) %>%
    add_bone_info() %>%
    mutate(std_element = gsub(" ", ".", element))

  # Process each skeleton section
  for (part in sections_order) {
    part_idx <- which(sections_order == part)
    current_level <- current_levels[part_idx]
    target_level <- target_levels[part_idx]
    
    # Initialize working data
    working_data <- current_mne_named %>%
      filter(Skeleton_Section == part) %>%
      select(std_element, count)

    iteration <- 1
    while(current_level > target_level) {
      intermediate_level <- max(target_level, current_level - 1)
      mapping_name <- paste0(part, "_", current_level, "_to_", intermediate_level)
      
      if (mapping_name %in% names(category_hierarchy)) {
        # Create element-category mapping
        element_map <- stack(category_hierarchy[[mapping_name]]) %>%
          setNames(c("child", "parent")) %>%
          mutate(
            child = gsub(" ", ".", child),
            parent = gsub(" ", ".", parent)
          )
        
        # Split data
        mappable <- working_data %>%
          inner_join(element_map, by = c("std_element" = "child"))
        
        non_mappable <- working_data %>%
          anti_join(element_map, by = c("std_element" = "child"))
        
        # Aggregate mappable elements
        aggregated <- mappable %>%
          group_by(parent) %>%
          summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          rename(std_element = parent)
        
        # SPECIAL SUMMATION LOGIC
        if(sum_cat) {
          working_data <- non_mappable %>%
            full_join(aggregated, by = "std_element") %>%
            mutate(count = coalesce(count.x, 0) + coalesce(count.y, 0)) %>%
            select(std_element, count)
        } else {
          working_data <- bind_rows(non_mappable, aggregated)
        }
        
        current_level <- intermediate_level
        iteration <- iteration + 1
      } else {
        warning(paste("Missing mapping:", mapping_name))
        break
      }
    }
    
    # Store final results
    if(nrow(working_data) > 0) {
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(working_data))) {
        element_name <- paste(part, working_data$std_element[i], sep = "_")
        new_mne[[element_name]] <- working_data$count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Convert to tibble
  new_mne_df <- tibble(
    element = names(new_mne),
    count = unlist(new_mne)
  )
  
  return(new_mne_df)
}
```

```{r}
summarize_bone_sections_zero_na <- function(input_df, reference_df = elements_data) {
  # Filter out rows where input_df$element is 0 or NA
  input_df <- input_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(input_df$count) & input_df$count != 0)


  # Add bone info using the filtered input_df
  bone_info_df <- add_bone_info(input_df, reference_df)

  # Define the ordered list of skeleton sections
  sections_order <- c("Skull", "Hyoid", "Vertebrae", "Thorax", "Shoulder",
                      "Arms", "Hands", "Pelvic", "Legs", "Foot")

  # Summarize the minimum Level for each section
  summary_df <- bone_info_df %>%
    group_by(Skeleton_Section) %>%
    summarize(min_level = min(Level, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Create a named vector with all sections, initializing with 1 (instead of NA)
  result_vector <- setNames(rep(1, length(sections_order)), sections_order)

  # Fill in the result_vector with available data
  for (section in sections_order) {
    if (section %in% summary_df$Skeleton_Section) {
      level <- summary_df$min_level[summary_df$Skeleton_Section == section]
      # If the level is NA, keep it as 1, otherwise use the actual level
      result_vector[section] <- if(is.na(level)) 1 else level
    }
    # If the section is not in summary_df, it will remain 1
  }

  # Return just the numeric vector without names
  return(unname(result_vector))
}
```

```{r}
prepare_tuning_input_from_tibble <- function(
  tapho_db,
  feature_col = "CumulativeReMNAU"
) {
  stopifnot(feature_col %in% names(tapho_db))
  stopifnot("site_id" %in% names(tapho_db))
  stopifnot("taphonomic_context" %in% names(tapho_db))
  stopifnot("element" %in% names(tapho_db))

  # use the first row's element labels as predictor names
  feature_names <- as.character(unlist(tapho_db$element[[1]], use.names = FALSE))

  # validate that every row has the same element labels in the same order
  same_structure <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(tapho_db)), function(i) {
    this_names <- as.character(unlist(tapho_db$element[[i]], use.names = FALSE))
    identical(this_names, feature_names)
  }, logical(1))

  if (!all(same_structure)) {
    bad_rows <- which(!same_structure)
    stop(
      paste0(
        "element labels/order are not identical across rows. ",
        "Problem rows: ", paste(bad_rows, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  # validate that each feature vector matches the element length
  vec_lengths <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(tapho_db)), function(i) {
    length(unlist(tapho_db[[feature_col]][[i]], use.names = FALSE))
  }, integer(1))

  if (!all(vec_lengths == length(feature_names))) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Length mismatch between element names (", length(feature_names),
        ") and ", feature_col, " vectors: found lengths ",
        paste(unique(vec_lengths), collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  feature_mat <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(tapho_db[[feature_col]], function(x) {
      as.numeric(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))
    })
  )

  feature_df <- tibble::as_tibble(feature_mat)
  names(feature_df) <- make.names(feature_names, unique = TRUE)

  input_df <- tibble::tibble(
    site_name = as.character(tapho_db$site_id),
    taphonomic_context = tapho_db$taphonomic_context
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(feature_df)

  input_df
}
```

```{r}


tapho.load <- function(new_site_data){
  
  new_site_meta <- new_site_data[1:11,]
  new_site_raw <- new_site_data[-c(1:11),]
  target_levels <- summarize_bone_sections_zero_na(new_site_raw)
  
  new_site_raw$count[is.na(new_site_raw$count)] <- 0
  
  recalc_new_site_raw <- recal_mne_six(as.numeric(new_site_raw$count), target_levels, skeleton_hierarchy, new_site_raw$element, sections_order)
  
  one_skeleton = get_bones_dataframe(target_levels)
 
  data_aligned <- align_loaded_data(one_skeleton$element, recalc_new_site_raw$element, recalc_new_site_raw$count)
  
  tapho_loaded <- loaded_tapho(new_site_meta$count, target_levels, data_aligned$element, data_aligned$count)

return(tapho_loaded) 

}
```
